tables.name: mart_air_category_days
tables.description: Count of days in each AQI category, bucketed by the WORST PM2.5 reading anywhere in the metro that day, so rare wildfire-smoke days show up instead of being averaged away. Drives the air-quality category bar chart.

columns.name: day_count
columns.description: Number of metro-days whose worst reading fell in this band.

columns.name: severity
columns.description: 1–6 sort key ordering the bands from Good to Hazardous.

tables.description: Monthly average and peak AQI by pollutant — surfaces the late-summer smoke spikes.

columns.name: max_aqi
columns.description: Worst single AQI reading in the month.

tables.name: mart_air_observations
tables.description: Puget Sound monitor/day/pollutant observations with stable EPA site IDs and county FIPS. Configured for ten counties; inspect actual loaded coverage before claiming regional completeness. Missing observations are not zeros. Use this mart for county filters before aggregating daily peaks.

columns.name: county_fips
columns.description: Five-digit state/county FIPS; filter here for county comparisons.

columns.name: site
columns.description: EPA local monitor name; names alone are not unique IDs.

columns.name: aqi
columns.description: Rounded average of AQI-bearing source rows per site/day/pollutant.

columns.name: aqi_category
columns.description: Category based on the average AQI before rounding.

tables.name: mart_air_sites
tables.description: One row per stable EPA PM2.5 monitor ID for the map — location plus its average and worst AQI.

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Nine-digit EPA state/county/site identifier; stable across name changes.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Monitor latitude (fixed per site; averaged defensively).

columns.name: avg_aqi
columns.description: Mean AQI over the loaded window.

columns.name: max_aqi
columns.description: Worst AQI over the loaded window.

columns.name: day_count
columns.description: Number of days the monitor reported.

tables.name: mart_air_worst_days
tables.description: The metro's 15 worst air days — highest single PM2.5 AQI per date, with the site that recorded it. Almost all smoke days.

columns.name: max_aqi
columns.description: Highest PM2.5 AQI recorded anywhere in the metro that day.

columns.name: site
columns.description: Monitor that recorded the worst reading.

tables.name: mart_build_info
tables.description: Warehouse build metadata — the data-freshness surface. One row holding built_at (dbt run_started_at, frozen into the baked warehouse) and total_records (the nine grain counts the Overview headline reports, defined here once). The Overview page reads it for its "Warehouse built <date>" banner. Because production rebuilds the warehouse from scratch every deploy, built_at is an honest "data loaded" timestamp.

columns.name: built_at
columns.description: Timestamp this `dbt build` began — the warehouse's build/load time.

columns.name: total_records
columns.description: Total records across the nine headline grain tables.
